svg.title: JE2 poster methods: design, proteomics and analysis
svg.desc: Three editable vector panels show27biologicalsamples,paired measurement layers,andseparate total-protein/phosphosite analysis branches. Artwork is original and schematic.

g.title: JE2 experimental design
g.desc: PAO1 spent medium is sterile-filtered before JE2 exposure. Nine genotype-by-condition groups each have three biological samples. Pulse is15minutes; long exposure isapproximately15hours.
g.text: Growth in TSB, then 15 min PASN
3 genotypes x 3 conditions x 3 biological replicates = 27 samples

g.title: JE2 total-proteome and phosphoproteome acquisition
g.desc: The same27 biological samples feed total-protein and Fe-IMAC-enriched phosphosite measurements. Both branches use LC-MS/MS. Original editable vector artwork.

g.text: 27 biological samples; each sample measured in both layers

g.title: JE2 protein and phosphosite analysis workflow
g.desc: Separate protein interaction and within-medium phosphosite comparisons feed functional enrichment, association networks, Venn sets and sequence logos. Protein-site matching prioritises candidates; direct substrates or occupancy are not established.
g.text: TSB vs long-exposure SN is the main focus
Interaction = (A_TSB - B_TSB) - (A_SN - B_SN), using log2 signals
